sections.Profile:
In August 1957, Bally released another pinball machine titled "Carnival," this time as a two-player, electro-mechanical game. This version features a widebody cabinet, four flippers, three pop bumpers, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1957
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Wood Rail, Carnival, Circus, Original Theme
